d: The square of S. Ambrogio. He hears happy music in the temple.
Pagano, Arvino, Viclinda, Giselda, Pirro from the temple, preceded by the Priors of the city, and Servants carrying torches etc, and sayings.
Internal chorus of Claustrali.
Pagano and Pirro.
Choir of Sgherri and sayings.
Gallery in the palace of Folco, which puts from the left in the rooms of Arvino, from the right in other apartments. The scene is illuminated by a lamp. Viclinda, Giselda then Arvino.
Pirro and Pagano.
Pirro solo, and Giselda, finally Pagano with bloody dagger, and Viclinda.
Arvino, Giselda, Pirro, Armigeri, Servite with torches, and sayings.
Hall of the Palace of Acciano in Antioch. Aciano is seated on the throne, before him are the Ambassadors, Soldiers and People.
Oronte, and Sofia veiled.
Prominence of a practicable mountain where a cave opens... a hermit.
Pyrrhus is said.
The Hermit enters the cave with Pyrrhus, and comes out with a helmet and a sword. Meanwhile, the Crusader warriors, preceded by Arvino, lie on the mountain.
The court of the harem, the choir of women who accompany Giselda, who abandons herself halfway over a seat.
Giselda rising impetuously.
Turkish soldiers chased by the Crusaders, then Women of Harem and Sofia.
Arvino, the Hermit and Lombard Knights.

The valley of Jehoshaphat, scattered with various practicable hills among which the olive trees excels. In the distance we see Jerusalem. Crusader knights, Women, Pilgrims, who come out in a procession at the head uncovered.
Giselda alone.
Oronte in a Lombard costume.
Arvino's tent.
Knights crusaders and said.
An interior of a cave. From an opening at the bottom I saw the banks of the Jordan. Giselda, who supports Oronte wounded.
The Hermit and sayings.
Cave. Giselda is abandoned on a rock. Enter the Hermit and Arvino.
Giselda alone; she is surprised in a dream by a vision of heavenly spirits.
The Lombard tents at the tomb of Rachel. Crusaders, Pilgrims, and Women.
Giselda, the Hermit, Arvino and sayings.
The Arvino tent. After a long battle noise, the Hermit, supported by Giselda and Arvino, enters.
The tent is opened and Jerusalem is seen; on the walls, on the towers, the flags of the cross are waving illuminated by the first rays of the east sun. Pilgrims, Women and Crusader Warriors.
